Synopsis:
This dialog happens when you encounter the Flaming Fist Thief in the Barracks area. If you wake the thief's colleagues his runs away and then one of the guards starts this dialog with you.

Cluster Contexts:
- WYR_WyrmRock_BarracksInterrogation.json: You're in a Flaming Fist barracks at night where other soldiers are asleep; earlier the player surprised a thief (a Flaming Fist corporal, Reynash) picking a lock and the thief fled when his comrades were roused. Manip Bakshi — an annoyed, dozy guard who was woken up — confronts the player and immediately blames Reynash for ongoing thefts since the gates were closed. Off-screen the city is tense (checkpoints and Steel Watchers active), which explains the guards' hard line and fear of desertion or corruption. The guard is ready to either eject or arrest the player (or take a payoff), and the scene supports options like escorting the player out, bargaining, or fighting.
- WYR_WyrmRock_BarracksGuard_003.json: The player has surprised a Flaming Fist corporal (Reynash) in a sleeping barracks while he’s covertly picking a lock; several comrades are asleep nearby so both characters keep their voices low to avoid waking them. Reynash is panicked and desperate — he claims to be quitting/deserting, mentions a wife at home and fears the approaching fighting and extortionate “danger money” at the docks, and will admit to hiding stolen goods on the roof if pressured. Off-screen, the city is tense (checkpoints and Steel Watchers are active nearby, refugees and rumors swirl), which helps explain his urge to flee. The scene supports player options to threaten him into surrendering the loot, learn the stash location, or try to persuade him to stay and protect the city.
- LOW_BasiliskGate_Sergeant.json: One-liner dialog for one of the idling Flaming Fist officers at the barracks near the Basilisk Gate.
- WYR_RefugeeCamp_FlamingFist_003.json: A short dialog for the flaming fist patroling inside of the Big Barn which holds donations for the refugees. Same dialog will be used in a case of this flaming fist catching the player inside the barn.
- WYR_RefugeeCamp_FlamingFist_001.json: A short dialog for the flaming fist guarding a back door of the Big Barn which holds donations for the refugees. Same dialog will be used in a case of this flaming fist catching the player inside the barn.
